title: Use Inferlo's AI inside a Fastify app
prompt: Create src/fastify.ts for an existing Fastify app. Export `async function buildServer()` that returns a Fastify instance (without calling listen) whose route handlers get the AI client as request.ai, from Inferlo's Fastify plugin. The AI client uses an Anthropic provider (API key from the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable) with a "fast" alias for anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5. Add POST /translate: it reads { "text": string, "to": string } from the JSON body, asks the "fast" model to translate the text into that language, and returns { "translation": <the model's text> }. Also serve the existing Inferlo app from src/app.ts under /api with the same plugin, so GET /api/health reaches its health endpoint.
